description: Submitted answers checked against their form: Required on the pages a respondent goes through (visibility rules and page jumps), answer rules and answer types. Run by backend/tests/app/services/test_answer_validation.py (every case) and webapp src/utils/answer-validation-cases.test.ts (the cases whose checks include 'required' or 'rules'). Checks 'server' are the server's alone: answer types and unknown ids (the respondent page builds its answers itself), and the cases in 'clientDiffers', which says why the browser differs on purpose. 'form' is the list of pages as the respondent page receives it; 'errors' lists every problem, in any order.
